title: Gold Rate Today, Aug 25: Check latest Gold prices in Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Chennai Delhi, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Kolkata & Other Cities - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
Gold prices up in India | Photo Credit: REUTERS

Gold prices in India rose today across all cities. The price for 8 grams of 24-carat gold also increased in all cities compared to yesterday. Below is a detailed breakdown of gold prices in key cities.

Gold prices in India today were ₹15,080 for 1 gram of 22-carat gold (up by ₹80) and ₹ 1,20,640 for 8 grams of 22-carat gold (up by ₹640).

22 Carat: The gold prices in Mumbai today were ₹15,080 for 1 gram of 22-carat gold (up by ₹80) and ₹1,20,640 for 8 grams of 22-carat gold (up by ₹640).

24 Carat: The gold prices in Mumbai today were ₹15,834 for 1 gram of 24-carat gold (up by ₹84) and ₹1,26,672 for 8 grams of 24-carat gold (up by ₹672).

22 Carat: The gold prices in Chennai today were ₹15,030 for 1 gram of 22-carat gold (up by ₹80) and ₹1,20,240 for 8 grams of 22-carat gold (up by ₹640).

24 Carat: The gold prices in Chennai today were ₹15,782 for 1 gram of 24-carat gold (up by ₹84) and ₹1,26,256 for 8 grams of 24-carat gold (up by ₹672).

22 Carat: The gold prices in Hyderabad today were ₹15,030 for 1 gram of 22-carat gold (up by ₹80) and ₹1,20,240 for 8 grams of 22-carat gold (up by ₹640).

24 Carat: The gold prices in Hyderabad today were ₹15,782 for 1 gram of 24-carat gold (up by ₹84) and ₹1,26,256 for 8 grams of 24-carat gold (up by ₹672).

22 Carat: The gold prices in Delhi today were ₹5,130 for 1 gram of 22-carat gold (up by ₹80) and ₹1,21,040 for 8 grams of 22-carat gold (up by ₹640).

The gold prices in Delhi today were ₹15,887 for 1 gram of 24-carat gold (up by ₹84) and ₹1,27,096 for 8 grams of 24-carat gold (up by ₹672).

22 Carat: The gold prices in Ahmedabad today were ₹15,134 for 1 gram of 22-carat gold (up by ₹80) and ₹1,21,072 for 8 grams of 22-carat gold (up by ₹640).

24 Carat: The gold prices in Ahmedabad today were ₹15,891 for 1 gram of 24-carat gold (up by ₹86) and ₹1,27,128 for 8 grams of 24-carat gold (up by ₹672).

22 Carat: The gold prices in Bengaluru today were ₹15,134 for 1 gram of 22-carat gold (up by ₹74) and ₹1,21,072 for 8 grams of 22-carat gold (up by ₹592).

24 Carat: The gold prices in Bengaluru today were ₹15,891 for 1 gram of 24-carat gold (up by ₹78) and ₹1,27,128 for 8 grams of 24-carat gold (up by ₹624).

24 Carat: The gold prices in Kolkata today were ₹ 15,939 for 1 gram of 24-carat gold (up by ₹84) and ₹ 1,27,512 for 8 grams of 24-carat gold (up by ₹672).
